Good to know

Questions

How do I read these for free?

Subscribe to Kindle Unlimited on Amazon, then borrow any of the ebooks. You do not need a Kindle device: the free Kindle app works on phones, tablets, and computers.

Which Ashley Claudy book should I read first?

Ride if you like street racing and motorcycle clubs, Hustle for college football, Outside the Ropes for boxing and romantic suspense, and It Goes On for family secrets. The quiz on this site can pick for you.

Are the books standalones?

Ride, Wreck, Hustle, and It Goes On can each be read on their own. Outside the Ropes is a trilogy to read in order.

Are paperbacks and audiobooks available?

Most titles have a paperback, and the Hustle and Outside the Ropes audiobooks are on Audible.
